Senses.Explanation: The records use light and dark as a coordinated pair in visual conditions, questions, verses, and instructions; their attested relations include distinction, intermingling, reciprocity, and pairing. The graphs themselves mean “light or bright” and “dark.” The record uses the pair for visual conditions and as a coordinated pair in questions, verses, and instructions. Caoshan says, "mountains, rivers, and the great earth: light and dark are each distinct" (山河大地，明暗自殊). Another verse says, "light and dark intermingle—the pivot of killing and bringing to life" (明暗相參殺活機). A transmission verse says, "light and dark do not concern one another; each divides one half" (明暗不相干，彼此分一半). Frequent coordination with "form and emptiness" (明暗色空, 237 occurrences) places both pairs among the things named in the scene.
Senses.Note: Question forms distinguish "light within dark" and "dark within light," then ask about "light and dark together" (明暗雙雙). Ruibai says, "I do not ask about light and dark together; what about the affair facing us right now?" (明暗雙雙即不問，即今覿面事如何). Elsewhere a raised staff is said to contain mountains, rivers, earth, light, dark, form, and emptiness on its tip. The corpus supplies several relations—distinct, intermingling, unconcerned, and together—without reducing them to one abstract theory.

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source text (五燈全書(第34卷-第120卷)). (五燈全書)(第34卷-第120卷), Caoshan Baoji Xiong section. Caoshan Baoji Xiong is the exact speaker of the teaching-seat address in which mountains and rivers and the great earth have light and dark distinct of themselves. This is not Caoshan Benji.

Source text (五燈全書(第34卷-第120卷)). (五燈全書)(第34卷-第120卷), Huangbo Jicui Yong Anzhu section. Jicui Yong Anzhu is the exact speaker who composes the verse beginning ‘light and dark interpenetrate, the pivot of killing and giving life’ after Shenqi consults him, Weizang, and Huanglong Huinan. Huangbo Xiyun is not the actor.

Occurrences.Kwic: 明暗不相干。彼此分一半。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: (續傳燈錄), Lingyin Huiyuan section. Lingyin Huiyuan is the exact speaker and verse author: in his dated hall address he says light and dark have nothing to do with each other and this and that divide one half.

Occurrences.Kwic: 師云：「明暗雙雙即不問，即今覿面事如何？」
Occurrences.AttributionNote: (入就瑞白禪師語錄), public exchange. Ruibai Mingxue is the exact speaker of the stored question: after answering an unnamed monk's questions about light within dark and dark within light, Ruibai says that he will not ask about light and dark paired and asks about the affair directly before them.

Occurrences.Kwic: 山河大地、明暗色空總在山僧拄杖頭上
Occurrences.AttributionNote: (列祖提綱錄), Gulin Qingmao's continuing New Year's Eve addresses. Gulin is the exact speaker: lifting his staff, he says mountains, rivers, earth, light, dark, form, and emptiness are all atop it.

Occurrences.Kwic: 但不著文字隔渠兩頭捉汝不得免苦樂相形免明暗相酧
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Ancient Worthies (古尊宿語錄), Baizhang Huaihai discourse: Baizhang says that cutting off both sides avoids the reciprocal pairing of brightness and darkness.

Occurrences.Kwic: 山高水深是佛境界。日上月下雲騰鳥飛是佛境界。明暗色空壞空成住
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Extensive Record of Zhongfeng (天目中峰廣錄): Zhongfeng Mingben includes brightness and darkness among the conditions he identifies as the Buddha realm.
